description_en: Queries the automatic switchover settings of the primary and secondary instances of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例主备自动切换的设置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-ha-switch-config --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHASwitchConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

HAConfig.description_en:
The automatic primary/secondary switchover setting. Valid values:
Auto: The system automatically switches over between the primary and secondary instances upon a fault.
Manual: Automatic switchover has been temporarily disabled
HAConfig.description_zh:
主备自动切换设置，取值：
Auto：出现故障时自动切换主备实例。
Manual：已临时关闭自动切换

ManualHATime.description_en: The deadline for the temporary disabling of automatic switchover. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
ManualHATime.description_zh: 临时关闭截止时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
